headline: Growth trajectory intact, earnings visibility sustained

highlights: Result Update | Aadhar Housing Finance (AADHOS) ( `` ICICI Securities – Retail Equity Research Aadhar Housing Finance (AADHOS) CMP: ₹429 Target ₹ 550 (28%) Target Period: 12 months November 6, 2026 Growth trajectory intact, earnings visibility sustained About the stock : Established in 2010, Aadhar is the largest player in affordable housing space with AUM of ₹32,643 crore.

Investment Rationale: • Healthy disbursement momentum to support sustained AUM growth : Disbursements grew 22.1% YoY to ₹2,577 crore, reflecting healthy underlying demand and improving visibility on loan book accretion.

Management's revised disbursement growth guidance of 18–20% (vs. 17– 18% earlier), coupled with lower BT-out at 5.1% (–40 bps YoY), aided by analytics-led customer engagement and retention initiatives, should support ~20% AUM.
While spreads moderated marginally to 5.7%, the largely floating-rate asset book allows loan repricing as funding cost increase, limiting sustained margin pressure.
